problem: MAJ3/source semantics admits exact history collisions, but historical Policy-0A cache equality also includes deterministic resolvents inherited from ancestor states. Determine whether those inherited clauses preserve almost all collision-history information or whether linearly many exact cache diamonds survive.

definitions.semantic_collision_pair: two reachable execution histories whose pure source restriction after cumulative branch+unit assignments is identical or belongs to the same exact MAJ3/Tseitin restriction class relevant to the candidate merge
definitions.historical_key: the byte-exact pre-local-Resolution canonical key actually used by Policy-0A, including resolvents inherited from ancestors
definitions.resolution_fingerprint: the part of the historical key whose presence/absence distinguishes two histories after their pure source restrictions have already converged
definitions.forgotten_collision_bit: an independent binary history choice for which the two branches later reach one byte-identical historical key
definitions.serial_diamond: the exact execution-DAG object defined in TRUMP_C023R_EXACT_EXECUTION_DAG_PATH_MULTIPLICITY_THEOREM_2026-09-15.md

pass_route.name: NEAR_INJECTIVE_INHERITED_RESOLUTION_FINGERPRINT
pass_route.target: Construct an explicit key-computable or provenance-replayable fingerprint J such that for every reachable key K, all but o(L) independent history bits among contexts reaching K are determined by J(K) together with the pure source restriction class.
pass_route.consequence: Combined with an exact bound for the remaining MAJ3/cycle-space ambiguity, obtain log2 m(K)=o(L).
pass_route.proof_requirement: The fingerprint must be defined from frozen resolution_trace/unit_trace/branch semantics and proved for all family members; no finite fitting.

fail_route.name: LINEAR_FINGERPRINT_FREE_SERIAL_DIAMONDS
fail_route.target: Construct on an infinite subsequence Omega(L) compatible serial diamonds where the two arms have different normalized histories but converge to byte-identical historical keys after all inherited local-Resolution effects.
fail_route.consequence: m(K)>=2^{Omega(L)} for a reachable target and FAIL_C023R_CACHE_FIBER_TRANSFER.
fail_route.proof_requirement: Each diamond must be justified by exact transition identities; semantic MAJ3 equality alone does not count.

first_symbolic_subgate.name: ONE_BLOCK_01_10_HISTORICAL_KEY_COLLISION_CONDITION
first_symbolic_subgate.question: For one frozen MAJ3 edge block with two assigned coordinates taking 01 versus 10, derive necessary and sufficient conditions on the inherited clause set and deterministic resolution/UP transition for the two histories to reach a byte-identical later key.
first_symbolic_subgate.required_output: An exact clause-set equality criterion, or a proof that no context-independent local criterion exists because cross-factor inherited provenance is essential.

controls: CACHE_DIAMOND must satisfy the fail-side notion of an exact key diamond and remains generic negative control.
MAJ3 01/10 source restriction equality alone must NOT be accepted as a historical key diamond.
Historical K4 reason-reuse observations are finite diagnostics only.
Any FBDD/OBDD/Resolution theorem is inadmissible until an explicit simulation from JANUS-FC_local is proved.
forbidden: probabilistic claims about which resolvents survive
assuming deterministic resolution is permutation invariant despite pivot/order budgets
changing resolution budgets/order or cache-key timing
using revealed K4 to choose an asymptotic exponent
post-result widening of the fingerprint language
